tables.title: Guild activities and Territory War
rows:
Time: 09:00, 16:00, 20:00 (1 hour each)
Description:
Gather resources from the Resource War map and deliver them to the Guild Manager.
1. Teleports are disabled in the war zone.
2. Resources drop if the player is killed.
Rewards:
10 Progress
10 Contribution
250 Honor
12 Bronze Medals.

Description:
Guild members can trade items for Qualify Pts once registration opens. The Top 2 guilds by 20:00 Friday will qualify for the Guild Showdown.

Description:
Qualified members should enter early to coordinate for the upcoming battle.

Visible Friday 20:00 – Saturday 20:30!
War Rules:
Enter the battlefield early to prepare. Capture footholds to earn points:
1 Foothold: +1 Pt/s
2 Footholds: +2 Pts/s
3 Footholds: +4 Pts/s
4 Footholds: +6 Pts/s
5 Footholds: +10 Pts/s
Battle ends when time expires or a side reaches 3,000 points. The winning guild gains territory control for one week.

The guild that slays the Spirit Golem wins mining rights for 24 hours.
The vein generates Guild Progress and Wealth over time (Must be claimed by the Leader/Vice-Leader).
Location: Kaymo Mountain.

Stones spawn at Kaymo Mountain.
Occupiers: Transport stones to the Guild Manager in Starglade.
Rivals: Intercept and plunder the transporters.
Bonus: Safe delivery grants double Contribution and Stone rewards.

Boss Info:
Spawns on Yueqi Mountain Line 1. The boss's drops belong to the guild that lands the final blow.
Respawn Time:
Every 3 hours
Monster Rewards:
Guild funds
Guild contribution
Other generous rewards
Every day, the Guild Leader can activate an exclusive Guild Bonfire in the Guild Map, granting all guild members a large amount of XP.
